test_title: SSC MTS (2022) Official Paper (Held On: 18 May, 2023 Shift 3)
subject: general
question:
**In the following question, out of the given four alternatives, select the alternative which best expresses the meaning of the Idiom/Phrase.**

To go a long way

options.text: To go on a long drive

solution:
The correct answer is: "**To become successful in life**."

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

 
• The phrase "**to go a long way**" means to achieve success or make significant progress.
 
• It implies that someone has achieved much or has a promising future ahead of them.
 
• It can refer to a person's career, personal goals, or even a project or endeavour.
 
 
• **Example**: "*If you work hard and stay focused, you can go a long way in your chosen field.*"
 
 

Therefore, the correct answer is **option 1**.
